name: Adoption report

  You ran CDA on your own research program — tell us how it went. The

  test, so these reports (including failures!) are the most valuable
  feedback this project can receive.
title: "[adoption] "
labels: adoption

(all of this is in each report's header and Run Parameters section)

**Were the registers interpretable?** Did the LLM's labels survive your
reading of the representative passages? Did you overrule any?

**Did the divergence flags change anything?** The design goal is that a
flag changes a manuscript decision — a definition added, a term split, a
section reframed, or a deliberate "no, my usage is the contribution." Did
that happen? What did you do?

**Surprises / failures** — premature saturation, compound-term collocation
clusters, thin researcher pools, anything the interpretation guide didn't
prepare you for:

**Setup friction** — how long from clone to first real report, and what was
the worst step?

**May we mention your adoption (field + corpus scale only) in revisions or
talks about the tool?** yes / no / ask first
